rule: Fill-path only. Stamp name= stays catalog official_field_key (TIN/branch). Unstamped leftover writer keys may be copied onto the existing cell-id name= when the freeze sheet has exactly one fillable under a printed caption that matches one leftover-unique fields.json key, and the identity catalog names that cell as html_id_hint. That is not an official_field_key harvest. Text joins ASCII-uppercase letters into comb slots and data-writer-value for BIR CAPITAL LETTERS print; digits and punctuation are unchanged. Do not mutate profile/DB values. R3 peso+cent tax rows may be listed in money_joins: one leftover money key maps to peso_html_id plus cent_html_id. Split the writer {:.2} string: pesos right-aligned in the peso comb (leading slots empty, not zero-padded, no decimal glyph), cents in the 2-slot comb. Do not stamp name= on either comb. Do not left-align the dotted string into the peso comb. Do not join leftover keys that share an item number with another leftover except as documented here.
